name: @tuvren/session-client
description: Thin, zero-dependency reference remote peer for the Tuvren duplex session protocol over WebSocket (ADR-0060/ADR-0061/ADR-0062/ADR-0063): runs where tools actually execute (browser, Bun, Node >=22) and speaks the handshake/frame/heartbeat wire vocabulary a host server exposes via DuplexSessionBinding -> RemoteClientSession -> createWsSessionTransport.
